name: Furniture catalog
note: Shared sizes for every furniture piece in every plan. A piece in a plan references a kind and must use these dimensions, either as w x d or swapped; it is never shrunk to fit. w is the long face, d the depth.

sofa.label: Sofa
sofa.note: Apartment 3-seater. Larger crowds a 143" wide living room.

armchair.label: Armchair
armchair.note: Compact, so a pair fits without eating the floor.

dining-table.label: Dining table
dining-table.note: Largest that clears the 76" dining room depth. Nominally 8 places, but the room cannot pull out end chairs, so 5-6 in practice.

bench.label: Bench
bench.note: Backless; tucks fully under the table when not in use.

twin-bed.label: Bed
twin-bed.note: Standard twin mattress. Yuna's bed; sized to last past the second child.

futon.label: Futon
futon.note: Footprint folded as a sofa. Opens to 75 x 54 for a guest.

desk.label: Desk
desk.note: Fits the 77 x 54 storage room on the short wall, clear of the inward door swing.

small-desk.label: Desk
small-desk.note: Small writing desk; primary bedroom, by the window.

low-shelf.label: Low shelf
low-shelf.note: Child height, open front, everything visible and reachable.

storage-cabinet.label: Cabinet
storage-cabinet.note: Yuna's room has no closet; this holds what a closet would.

play-mat.label: Play mat
play-mat.note: 5' square = 25 sq ft exactly. Counts as play floor, not as furniture covering it.
